name: OpenWeather
description: Global current weather, 5-day forecasts in 3-hour steps, and geocoding from OpenWeather. These endpoints are available on the free Weather API plan with an API key. One Call and paid historical products are not included.

credential_fields.name: api_key
credential_fields.label: API Key
credential_fields.description: Create an account at https://home.openweathermap.org/users/sign_up and copy a key from https://home.openweathermap.org/api_keys. Newly created keys may take time to activate.

tools.name: get_current_weather
tools.description: Get current weather by coordinates. Resolve a city name with geocode_location first.

units.description: metric: Celsius and m/s; imperial: Fahrenheit and mph; standard (provider default when omitted): Kelvin and m/s.

lang.description: Language code for weather descriptions, for example en, fr, or es.

tools.name: get_forecast
tools.description: Get the next 5 days of weather in 3-hour steps. cnt limits timestamps, not days. The full response includes city metadata and the list of forecasts.

units.description: metric: Celsius and m/s; imperial: Fahrenheit and mph; standard (provider default when omitted): Kelvin and m/s.

lang.description: Language code for weather descriptions, for example en, fr, or es.

cnt.description: Number of 3-hour forecast timestamps; omit for the full forecast.

tools.name: geocode_location
tools.description: Find coordinates for a city or area. Disambiguate with country and optional US state code.

q.description: City name, optional US state code, and ISO country code separated by commas, e.g. Paris,FR or Portland,OR,US.

tools.name: reverse_geocode
tools.description: Find nearby place names for coordinates.

tools.name: geocode_postcode
tools.description: Resolve a postal code and country to coordinates.

zip.description: Postal code and ISO country code separated by a comma, e.g. 75001,FR.
